name: Austin Sellers
biography: Austin Sellers is a Detection Engineer at Volexity where he focuses on automating large scale memory analysis and threat detection techniques. He has significant experience in developing memory analysis datasets that allow for automated verification and testing of kernel and userland memory forensics techniques.
